collection.title: BMW Z1 1988 to 1991 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW Z1 Roadster 1988 to 1991 requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
